tool_args.rationale: The initial rows show positive gain only at short horizons, consistent with multiple smooth mechanisms. A discriminating long-horizon observation is needed to establish whether endogenous adaptation produces the predicted reversal before fitting.

That batch is for identifying trajectory-based memory ODEs; the observed signatures and archive instead point to dual-horizon adaptation.
